scenario: A runaway trolley is heading toward 5 workers on the main track. Maria can pull a lever that switches the trolley onto a side track, where 1 worker stands. If she pulls the lever, the trolley will kill that worker and spare the 5. If she does not, it will kill the 5 and spare the 1. Maria cannot stop the trolley. Should she pull the lever?
